name: Ichiban Oishii Gomi Dake Tabesasete
original_name: いちばん美味しいゴミだけ食べさせて
source:
An adult product known as a “Lovely Doll.” Miali, a life-size doll who somehow comes to life, grows smarter with every bite of garbage… Choose her daily menu, nurture her, and build a bond in this visual novel.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3770380/Please_Serve_Only_the_Most_Delicious_Garbage/]Steam[/url]]
